policy: Magnolia is reserved for accelerator work that materially advances the model
Kaggle is a network-capable acquisition fallback rather than a default execution target
local and GitHub work is preferred for code, evaluation logic, manifests, curricula, and branch updates
the 200-step P100 MLM segment is durable real model lineage, not throwaway qualification
continue healthy training from checkpoints instead of restarting
only reopen infrastructure investigation when a new concrete failure invalidates a closed assumption
builder_lesson: Infrastructure validation has diminishing returns. Once acquisition, transfer, runtime, DDP, and import are proven, the builder should spend scarce remote compute on durable model learning and use checkpointed evidence to drive the next training decision.
next_action: first durable public N0 MLM training segment, then evidence-driven continuation into curriculum and identity supervision
